summary: Bug fix verification for automatic page reload issue. All 7 fixes verified: TypeWriter useEffect dependency fix, useEffect selectedDeviceId empty dependency fix, Zustand store memory limits (200 transcripts, 50 suggestions, 2000 chars max), beforeunload protection during active sessions, render loop detection. Page loads correctly with 0 JS errors and remains stable for 10+ seconds.
critical_code_review_comments: TypeWriter useEffect FIXED: Dependencies [currentIndex, text, speed] with textRef to prevent reset loops on streaming text
Device useEffect FIXED: Empty dependency array [] - runs only once on mount, uses prev callback to avoid self-referential loop
Memory limits VERIFIED: MAX_TRANSCRIPT_LINES=200, MAX_SUGGESTIONS=50, MAX_SUGGESTION_TEXT_LENGTH=2000 in interviewStore.js
beforeunload protection VERIFIED: Warns user when status is 'recording' or 'processing'
Render loop detection VERIFIED: Logs error if >100 renders in <10ms timeframe
Emergency reset button added for stuck state recovery
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes for automatic page reload verified. Page is stable with 0 console errors. Key fixes: TypeWriter useEffect dependency, devices useEffect empty dep array, Zustand store memory limits. Start button is disabled until API key is configured (expected behavior).

typewriter_useeffect_fix.details: Dependencies correctly set to [currentIndex, text, speed]. Uses textRef.current to track text changes and only resets when text is completely new (not just growing). Lines 17-37 in Interview.jsx

device_useeffect_fix.details: Empty dependency array [] - runs only once on mount. Uses setSelectedDeviceId(prev => prev || ...) to avoid triggering re-runs. Line 400 in Interview.jsx

memory_limits_store.details: MAX_TRANSCRIPT_LINES=200, MAX_SUGGESTIONS=50, MAX_SUGGESTION_TEXT_LENGTH=2000 constants in interviewStore.js lines 26-28. Store functions slice arrays when limits exceeded.

beforeunload_protection.details: Window beforeunload event listener warns user when status is 'recording' or 'processing'. Lines 273-285 in Interview.jsx

render_loop_detection.details: Tracks renderCountRef and lastRenderTimeRef. Logs error '[RENDER] Potential infinite loop detected!' if >100 renders in <10ms. Lines 253-270 in Interview.jsx

no_page_reload.details: Page remained stable and responsive for 10+ seconds during testing with 0 console errors

start_button_functional.details: Button is visible and correctly disabled when no API key configured. Will be enabled once API key is set.
